summary: ACCEPT. Fresh independent plan-only review found no blocking finding, Critical/High issue, Constitution MUST violation, authority conflict, unresolved placeholder, or infeasible architecture/test seam in the pinned corrected boundary. Failure-24 establishes an implementation/request-contract defect rather than an environment, network, authentication, database, timeout, or streaming-stall condition: the immediately preceding source-free T083 request succeeded, while the first production T084 request returned structured HTTP 400 invalid_request_error/schema and exposed different sanitized function-schema hashes plus response_format, tool_choice, and parallel_tool_calls. AD-19 and R-19 close that gap at the earliest plan owner without weakening code-logic/file-v2 or changing host configuration. One deterministic DeepSeekStrictToolDeclarations authority is built from the two actual AIFunction public OpenAI declarations, validates exact ordered names, descriptions, strict flags and closed schemas, and supplies byte/hash-identical complete declaration bytes to both the source-free handshake and every production Worker turn. The executor-local final-wire seam is feasible at the existing bounded HttpMessageHandler immediately before HttpClientPipelineTransport: after duplicate-aware provisional parsing and the separately authorized token/thinking construction, it may omit only one exact tool_choice:auto, parallel_tool_calls:false, and JSON response_format, substitute only the accepted declaration blob, and complete only absent/null assistant tool-call content to an empty string. Alternate, duplicate, malformed, or conflicting forms reject before transport; existing string content, complete reasoning_content, tool calls, matching tool results, endpoint/model selection, streaming, timeouts, zero SDK retries, and all accepted numeric budgets remain unchanged. The design is testable through an honest T093 RED followed by T094 production GREEN, T095 source-free harness GREEN, and T096 source-free qualification before any fresh T084 source-bearing run; fake-wire tests bind exact declaration bytes, forbidden-field absence, non-null content, reasoning/tool continuity, malformed/alternate no-send behavior, sibling-client isolation, final body measurement, and no request eleven. The source-free handshake remains bounded, uses fixed non-source content, enables thinking, never invokes a returned function or sends a tool result, and records only sanitized hashes, sizes, classifications, and timestamps. Provisional/final request bodies, source, prompts, reasoning, tool arguments/results, credentials, provider content, validator internals, and host paths remain execution-local and nonlogged/nonpersistent. The correction adds no database, EF migration, API, UI, durable state, provider circuit, scheduling, dispatch, local validation, persistence authority, system/host/environment/network/global configuration change, Story 12.4 Cross-Repository Resolution, or Story 12.5 behavior. The unchanged specification already requires actual strict-provider compatibility, complete reasoning/content/tool replay, privacy, source-free-before-source qualification, and fail-closed behavior, so no specification change is required. The updated Task-Generation Impact correctly orders T093 -> T094 -> T095 -> T096 -> T084 and does not authorize implementation. ACCEPT advances to fresh definition review under the user's standing continuation authorization without another duplicate approval pause; it does not waive task/definition analysis, TDD, qualification, convergence, quality, E2E, verification, lifecycle, staging, commit, or Git-history gates. The nonrecursive diff identity is SHA-256 over UTF-8 sorted repository-path, tab, lowercase file-SHA-256 rows for the five owned paths, joined by LF with no trailing newline.
